description: This file defines the interface for the LZF compression/decompression algorithm, including version info and function prototypes for compressing and decompressing data.

methods.name: lzf_compress
methods.description: Compresses input data into output buffer, returning the number of bytes used or 0 on error.

methods.name: lzf_decompress
methods.description: Decompresses data compressed with lzf_compress, returning the number of decompressed bytes or 0 on error.
